bootstrap: paired call-cluster percentile, random.Random(42), 2000 resamples, calls drawn with replacement in sorted order; linear percentile interpolation; any undefined replicate makes that CI unknown, never silently discarded
case_sensitive_column: Same NFKC/punctuation-to-space lexical pipeline without casefold; descriptive and not WER v1.
context: Per-conversation sorted exact-string union of supplied dictionary metadata, pinned CONVERSATION-CONTEXTS.json; every raw result is rechecked against current immutable plan/source/model/tokenizer/runtime/corpus/clip/context/recipe, preserving original grant identity.
engine_errors: terminal failures counted as blank hypotheses/full deletions; exposed interruptions remain UNKNOWN and block definitive selection
folded_normalization: Uniform NFKC, punctuation-to-space, whitespace tokenization and casefold on every reference, hypothesis and per-item native keyword; lexical keyword F is separate from P-STT-1 WER.
in_window: Each native result must bind a sampled child-live observation and successful boosted cells must retain the actual expected nonempty-trie alpha trace.
keyword_reference: each clip native keywords, same across every arm; never the selected context list
masking: LEX1 term-masked lexical reference agreement: uniform NFKC punctuation-to-space word tokenization, same per-clip keyword terms for every arm, casefolded for the primary column; delete term spans in both strings then pooled edit distance / reference tokens over every original row. This is not P-STT-1 v1 WER or a speech release claim.
noise_floor: Larger absolute endpoint of paired 95% bootstrap interval of LEX1 lexical term-masked WER difference between global-zero and local-zero dev repeats over all original rows; undefined denominator means UNKNOWN.
raw_token_unk: unobserved unless native emitted-token evidence is added; null, never assumed zero
selection: all 12 Nemo alpha/scope cells including alpha 0, maximize folded pooled keyword F, tie lower alpha then global; undefined candidate F blocks selection
test_guard: No test paths read. DEV-SELECTION.json is create-exclusive only after all expected 1500 native results, no exposed unknowns and defined candidate F. Heldout plan requires actual selection AND a known prospective LEX1 lexical noise floor.
v1_status: Compute unmodified stt_norm/v1 reference/hypothesis/keyword statuses and text-level UNK counts independently and preserve flagged statuses separately. Raw token UNK remains unobserved/null. LEX1 lexical metrics do not claim P-STT-1 v1 WER.
